channel.title: Architecture | Marco Troisi
channel.description: Marco Troisi is a founder, fractional CTO and software architect. Through O2A Labs he helps founders make sound technical decisions and build software that serves the business.

item.title: When to use microservices (video)
item.description: I was recently interviewed on "when to use microservices". Find out what I said!

item.title: Microservices won’t improve your code quality
item.description: I am very excited about microservices, but they are not going to make my code quality better. That will always be up to the programmer.

item.title: Technical debt is not a unicorn
item.description: Technical debt is not an abstract concept. It has real and serious effects, and can be avoided.
